{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for commas in revenue
print("Rows with commas in revenue:")
print(df[df['revenue'].str.contains(',', regex=False)])

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check if any revenue is suspiciously high (e.g., 999999.99) — internal QA orders
suspicious_revenue = df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print(f"Number of suspicious revenue entries (999999.99): {suspicious_revenue.sum()}")

# Filter out the suspicious rows
df_clean = df[~suspicious_revenue]

# Check the shape after removal
print(f"Original shape: {df.shape}, Cleaned shape: {df_clean.shape}")"}
